column6: さん。いらっしゃ{08:89}せ。\nご用件を{08:90}ぞ。\n
column11: reads: さん。いらっしゃいませ。\nご用件をどうぞ。\n

column8: It's always good to be prepared.\nHere's everything we have on sale. Please, have a look.\n
column11:
reads: そなえあれば憂い無し。どれも良い品ですよ。
ゆっくり見ていって下さい。

column8: Sorry, but it seems like you don't have anything\nwith you that I can buy.\n
column11: reads: うちで扱ってる物を持っていないみたいですよ。\n; reads: うちで扱ってる物を持っていないみたいですよ。\n @refalign

column6: どれを買い取ればよろしい{08:55}か？\n
column8: What would you like to sell?\n
column11: reads: どれを買い取ればよろしいですか？\n; reads: どれを買い取ればよろしいですか？\n @refalign

column8: Sorry, but it seems like you don't have enough money.\n
column11: reads: ‥‥あの、お金が足りないようですが？\n; reads: ‥‥あの、お金が足りないようですが？\n @refalign

column6: お買い上げの品は{02:0E}でよろしい{08:55}ね？\n
column8: Will this be all?\n
column11: reads: お買い上げの品はこちらでよろしいですね？\n; reads: お買い上げの品はこちらでよろしいですね？\n @refalign

column8: You can't carry that much.\n
column11: reads: そんなに持ち切れませんよ。\n

column8: There's no upside to skimping on money for something like this.\n
column11: reads: こういう物にお金をけちってもいいことなんて\nありませんよ。\n

column8: Hmm, at that price...... At least come up to about this much.\n
column11: reads: うーん、その値では‥‥。せめて、このくらいで。\n

column8: All right! I'll sell it to you.\n
column11: reads: いいでしょう！ お売りします。\n

column8: Thank you very much.\nPlease be sure to follow the dosage and directions.\n
column11: reads: ありがとうございます。\n用法と分量は守って使って下さいね。\n

column6: 引き取る品は{02:0E}でよろしい{08:55}ね？\n
column8: These are the items you'd like to sell, correct?\n
column11: reads: 引き取る品はこちらでよろしいですね？\n

column8: That's way too expensive, no matter how you look at it.\n...... Could you bring it down a bit more?\n
column11: reads: いくらなんでも高すぎますよ。\n‥‥もう少し安くはなりませんか？\n

column8: That's a bit pricey.\n...... Could you get it down to at least about this much?\n
column11: reads: それじゃちょっと高いですね。\n‥‥せめてこのくらいになりませんか？\n

column8: All right. I'll buy it at that price.\n
column11: reads: いいでしょう。その値で買い取ります。\n

column8: Thank you very much.\n
column11: reads: ありがとうございます。\n

column8: Ah...... that's right.\n
column11: reads: あ‥‥そうだわ。\n

column8: Thank you very much. Please come by again.\n
column11:
reads: ありがとうございました。
次からもごひいきにお願いします。

I'd like you to have this, Katsuragi.\nIt's not much, but I hope it may prove useful on your journey.\n
